notes: §1985:VIII.4.9.3 SR1 "If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area." MoveBinder#BindFromPhrase applies the WRITE row (MoveBinder#Write): a function-identifier outside the alphanumeric (or national, which no 1985 function returns; NATIONAL-OF is edition-refused COBOL1502) category is refused COBOL1914, and StatementValidation#CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea, in force below 2023 (RecordAreaRule#InForce), refuses with COBOL6827 an operand StorageSharing#IsRecordAreaOf finds to be the record area: any 01 of the file or of a SAME RECORD AREA file, or an item at offset 0 as long as the record; a partial overlap (shorter subordinate, reference modification) is accepted, its MOVE result undefined. Probes at 85 on a random relative file: refused FROM REL-REC, another 01 REL-ALT, full-width subordinate REL-G1, SAME RECORD AREA record OTH-REC, LENGTH, SQRT, RANDOM, INTEGER, a literal and ALL "A" (COBOL0871, 2002 syntax); accepted and written: WS item, signed numeric (00012), subscripted table element, CURRENT-DATE, UPPER-CASE, REVERSE, CHAR(66), REL-H1 and REL-REC(1:5). The witness writes REL-REC FROM REL-REC and is refused with COBOL6827. Messages for COBOL1914 cite the 2023 SR4 wording at 85. || REFUTED: DIVERGES (accepts-illegal): WRITE record-name-1 FROM identifier-1 must be refused at --std 85 when identifier-1 is a record of a file named with record-name-1's file in a SAME AREA clause, or a level-66 RENAMES item that covers the whole record area (repro refute-rd-05/w7a.cob, two statements, both compile today). The sibling REWRITE FROM and the sequential/indexed WRITE FROM rows share StorageSharing#IsRecordAreaOf and need the same sweep. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read4/rd-05.json, refuter coderead-85/out-read4/rd-05-refute.json). || RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5412, wave 20262025 group B): StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf decides 'the same storage area' on the storage the operand denotes (StorageExtent.OfReference), not on its form, so a literal reference modification of the whole record (R (1:10); R (1:) whatever R's length), the element of a table of one occurrence and a 66 THROUGH alias of the whole record are refused COBOL6827, and a SAME AREA peer's record is the area too (1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1, FileModel.StorageSharingFiles); docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) is revised. The read-3 and read-4 probes are all refused now. The function sentence's COBOL1914 message now cites the 1985 rule of the file's module (kb/Work PB5486: FromPhraseRules.FunctionRuleCite is an EditionCite).

next.reason: Amended text (X3.23a-1989 added the function sentence, errata C137; X3.23b-1993 made the second sentence unconditional again, errata C276), §1985:VIII.4.9.3 SR1: 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' Two differences in 2023. (a) The function sentence is widened: §2023:14.9.51.3 SR4 'it shall reference an alphanumeric or national function' and, without the FILE phrase, §2023:14.9.51.3 SR11 'identifier-1 shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function'; 2023 accepts a national (or boolean) function 1985 refuses. (b) 2023 has no syntax rule refusing shared storage: §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 makes WRITE FROM an implicit MOVE and its NOTE 1 says 14.6.10 and the MOVE rules 'apply to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with record-name-1 share any part of their storage areas'; the result is then §2023:14.6.10 GR2 'the same as if the data items shared no part of their respective storage areas' (same data description entry) or §2023:14.6.10 GR1 'the result of the statement is undefined'. A refusal became acceptance with a defined or undefined result; no exception condition.
